portInfo.description: Nāwiliwili Harbor is Kauaʻi’s principal deep-draft commercial harbour on the island’s east side and one of ten State-managed commercial harbours noted in HDOT’s Kauai Commercial Harbors 2025 Master Plan. That plan states Pier 2 is utilized by both the domestic and international cruise industry, that the cruise passenger terminal continues at Pier 2, and that cruise ships will berth along Piers 1 and 2 or at Piers 2 and 3 to support simultaneous large-ship calls. A November 2026 HDOT administration item for revocable permits references a passenger screening area, office space and breakroom at Pier 2, Nawiliwili Harbor, which corroborates ongoing passenger processing at Pier 2. Berth scheduling for Hawaiʻi commercial ports uses Hawaii.PortCall.Com.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: East-side short tours (waterfall overlooks) — operator hours not verified.
Waimea Canyon — long call only with ≥120 min return buffer.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: On two-ship days, confirm whether you are on Pier 2 or an overflow pier before locking a distant tour pickup point.
